reason: The hypothesis combines the dilute carbon doping of a refractory HEA (P28, P31) with the TWIP/TRIP mechanism from a non-refractory, FCC-based HEA system (P22) and applies it to a specific BCC alloy (NbZrTiHfMo) not studied in either source, proposing a new mechanism (stacking fault energy modification via coherent carbides) to improve plasticity without strength loss. This synthesis of distinct concepts from different alloy families into a new material system goes beyond any single passage.
copied_elements: interstitial carbon enabling TWIP/TRIP mechanisms (P22, P25, P30)
